description:
Zero-click clipboard manager for Windows that lives on the left screen edge.

Trace is a Windows-only clipboard manager that lives on the left edge of your screen and expands on hover. It provides a zero-click panel, native OLE drag & drop to any desktop application, a task layer, and an AI suggestion pipeline.
v2026.8.16 — 安装器修复 + rebrand 收尾
